Congrats, Police Officer Class 08-2025! 👮‍♀️🎓

Today, we proudly welcomed 29 new police officers into the LVMPD family! This incredible group represents the best of our community:

🔹Ages range from 21 to 42
🔹12 are bilingual, speaking Arabic, Irani, Tagalog, Dari, Farsi, Samoan, and Spanish
🔹10 have earned college degrees
🔹2 are former LVMPD Explorers
🔹2 are former LVMPD Cadets
🔹1 is a former Police Officer
🔹3 are U.S. military veterans
🔹15 are Las Vegas natives, and 2 were born in Jamaica and the Philippines
🔹Previous employments: Aquatics Director, busser, deli clerk, mechanic, electrician, EMT, landscaper, painter, warehouse associate, and fire protection.

We’re honored to have each of you join the ranks. Your dedication, diversity, and drive will help shape the future of law enforcement in Las Vegas. Welcome to the Metro family! 💙🖤

#LVMPD #policeacademy #applynow #nowhiring
